events.verdict: Holiday (NOP) moves along Butler's (PHI) path, extending slightly to follow him as they separate.
Embiid (PHI) extends into Moore's (NOP) path, but Moore avoids the contact.
RLS shows Davis (NOP) cleanly dislodges the ball from Embiid (NOP).
Randle (NOP) establishes a legal picking position in Redick's (PHI) path before the contact.
Moore (NOP) has his hands on Redick's (PHI) arm/back but does not affect his FOM.
Redick (PHI) establishes a back screen in Randle's (NOP) path, giving him a step to avoid the contact.
Moore (NOP) extends into Simmons's (PHI) path but does not impede his progress.
Randle (NOP) has a bent forearm to Simmons's (PHI) side during the start of his shot, which collapses as he cleanly blocks the shot.
Chandler (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Holiday's (NOP) drive.
[Observable in enhanced video] Randle (NOP) maintains his pivot foot as he turns. He lifts it just as he releases the ball.
LATR shows Redick (PHI) and Moore (NOP) lean against one another and then push off to separate.
Moore (NOP) trails Redick (PHI) with a hand on him, but doesn't affect his SQBR.
Redick (PHI) gathers on his right foot and then takes two legal steps to jump and release his shot.
Davis (NOP) makes a legal attempt to block Redick's (PHI) shot.
Davis (NOP) establishes a legal screening position in Butler's (PHI) path, extending slightly but not affecting his ability to get around the screen.
Mirotic (NOP) legally attempts to block Simmons's (PHI) shot.
RATR shows Embiid (PHI) touches the ball after is has fully cleared the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Butler (PHI) moves along Holiday's (NOP) path during his drive, at one point leaning into him slightly. Holiday moves through the contact.
Redick (PHI) and Mirotic (NOP) briefly engage and disengage away from the ball.
After the inbound, Embiid (PHI) briefly places his hands to Davis's (NOP) sides, but does not bring them to a pause.
LAR and LLB show that Embiid (PHI) collapses his left arm during Holiday's (NOP) driving shot attempt and he cleanly knocks the ball away with his right.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows Simmons (PHI) step out of bounds.
RLB shows Davis (NOP) take a legal step-back.
Embiid (PHI) jumps A to B toward Davis (NOP) and makes contact with him while he is in the air.
